note: The hoop on its own post (Free play, where the walls fold half way back): the same board, rim and net as art/iso/props/hoop, held by arms from a post that stands on the floor 0.3 m out from the hoop wall. Placed like the hoop: its foot (0, 0, 0) is on the wall below the rim, 2.4 m up, so the post reaches down 2.4 m to the floor.
